That is arguably a better first evening than an empty values screen — the owner answers a reading rather than facing a blank page. His tap is the affirmation.

Worth writing into the bead's own deliverable sentence: what he says about a value the composer guessed is at least as interesting as what he says about the bundles.

title: The outcomes section — the crown on the feed
description: Per the spec: the 'This week could hold' section on top, weekly-capped, plan cards with their why (value, routing, evidence), verdict chips per the consent design, the crown-and-floor posture recorded (projections below stay the ledger). Registry entry + recipe line together; the exposure-floor law (8um law 3) applies to this section's slots.
design:
Spec: docs/spec-outcome-menu.md § 'The outcomes section — the crown, and its floor'.

THE CENSUS MOVES, and the bead's framing ('registry entry + recipe line together') is incomplete: this is the first bead in the tree to add a SECTION. feed/census becomes [:outcomes :do_now :decide :fuel :seam :archive]. The section enum of feed_recipe/order-schema is GENERATED from census, so the picker widens for free and — per 0k4's own correction — feed_recipe's fingerprint does NOT move (fingerprint-of is a whitelist over kind/machine/derived/storage; :schema is not in it).

FULL JOIN LIST, all of it waymark10: feed/census; the plans population defn; the populations registry entry; population-says; population-reads ([:nav] — this section reads no :over); card-says' section clause (a section with no sentence makes the citation lie by omission); default-recipe gains {:section :outcomes :population :plans :take 2}; 135-feed-screen.js FEED_SECTION_LABEL + FEED_SECTION_HINT; AND test/packs.clj's hard-coded above-seam #{"do_now" "decide"} literal, which appears TWICE (~2361, ~2546) and will silently judge the new section as below-seam if it is not widened. entry-cards' admits?/keep? need no new branch — a plan card with no verb left is retired at offer time instead.

THE WEEKLY CAP IS NOT HERE. It is jfv.3's create-door wall (plans-are-few, 2 per author per calendar week). The recipe's :take is per PAGE and stays 2; a read-side weekly window would bury plans the door already let be staged, would stop the composer having to rank, and would make the exposure floor unmeasurable (8um law 3: a learner cannot learn about a card it never shows). The recipe has no word for a week and must not grow one.

THE FLOOR: the line's :take IS the exposure floor. Today nothing ranks so it is trivially honored; the rule this bead FIXES for 8um.3 is that the formula may not reduce this line below its take while candidates exist, and a card held by the floor says so in its why. The population must keep NAMING candidates it did not show so claimed_above stays truthful. The crown-and-floor sentence is written verbatim in the spec — quote it, do not re-derive it.

THE POPULATION: names :plan and :plan_piece BY KEYWORD and answers [] when the engine holds neither — the letters/ticklers/insights precedent (this is the 4th and 5th optional app kind core names; if a 6th arrives, a declared read-trait like :over is the fix and that tipping point is recorded in the spec). Reads offered plans whose leash has not run out, DROPS THE READER'S OWN (four-eyes means carding a plan to its composer offers a door that 409s — what asks and insights already do), retires at offer time when the value is retired or every piece is answered, and hands each candidate a :sentence (the goal in value terms, the value named, the routing cited). Anchor any window on day-start, never on (:now ctx).

THE ONE WIRE WIDENING: a candidate gains an optional :parts key and feed/card renders each piece through the SAME envelope-summary -> :row? -> split-verbs path, copying the results onto the card as "pieces" — so a piece's chips are the piece row's own projected verbs and concealment holds exactly as it does for the parent. Justified by .5's sentence precedent. Bounded: at most 5 pieces x 2 cards of extra envelope renders per read.

THE SCREEN DISPATCHES ON CARD SHAPE, NEVER ON KIND — .7's own correction, and it binds doubly here because plan is a workqueue10 kind and 135-feed-screen.js is the framework's page. A card carrying pieces is a bundle: goal as heading, value+routing as its why, each piece a line with its own Not this chip, Make it so / Not this week as the card's chips. section/population/kind ride as data- attributes only.

SIZE WARNING: this is the epic's largest bead and the UI half is most of it (the feed epic's .7 was half that epic alone, and this is a card with sub-rows each carrying verbs). If it passes a day, split the screen half out — the wire half is independently provable off the document and the screen half is verified by hand per waymark10-design.md §10.

CONCURRENCY: this bead CANNOT run beside waymark-8um.1/.2/.3 — all four edit feed.clj, packs.clj and 135-feed-screen.js. Run 8um.1 first (its view-event door is what makes the diagnosis duty a duty, and this bead is the harder rebase because it moves the census); run THIS before 8um.3 (a floor law wants a line that is actually floored as its witness).

title: The plan kind — the composed bundle with honest consent
description: Per the spec: the plan kind with its create guards (names a value, cites evidence, routing cited, bundle coherence), verdict structure with partial decline that teaches, materialization through ordinary doors as the accepting member, decline-then-recompose lifecycle (tickler posture). The staged proposal (0k4) is the single-row precedent; this is the multi-row form.
design:
Spec: docs/spec-outcome-menu.md § 'The plan and its pieces' and § 'Materialization'.

TWO KINDS, NOT ONE — and this amends the bead's own framing. plan (the bundle: goal, value_id as a :kind ref, routing prose, optional routes_through, evidence addresses, composed_by/decided_by/good_until engine-written; states [:offered :accepted :declined :expired]) and plan_piece (plan_id ref, says, target_kind as a DECLARED :enum, prepared input, materialized address; states [:offered :taken :declined :moot]). Consent granularity is per piece because that is the only shape the code permits.

WHY A SELECTION-CARRYING VERDICT LOSES — structural, not taste, and this is the fork's verdict: (1) desugar-decision silently DROPS a verdict's :input unless :note is spelled (verdict-action's cond-> tests note-field), so accept{pieces:[...]} is not expressible in the sugar at all; (2) hand-written, demand/field-class never inspects an array's :items, so [:vector [:enum ...]] renders 'recall', heavier than feed/card-ceiling, and split-verbs moves the verdict off the card into heavier — waymark-iqa.4's note-lesson one shape over; (3) a single :kind ref WOULD render selection, but an action with an input is not a tap (.7 opens actionDialog for it), and the epic's unit of consent is a thumb.

DECLINE THE :decision SUGAR FOR BOTH, the recipe_proposal way, and keep g/not-the-field so the law is the sugar's law and not a lookalike. Three limits force it: verdict-keys has no :touches and both accepts cross-write; :decider has no principal-type dimension and 'a person, never an agent' is half the safety; the sugar has one open state and cannot express the moot arm. Filed as waymark-bro.

VERDICTS, all note-free and input-free so they stay chips: piece take (-> taken, materializes) / not_this (-> declined) / moot (-> moot); plan make_it_so (-> accepted, handler fans out ctx :invoke on every still-offered piece's take, :touches [{:kind :plan_piece :action :take}]) / not_this_week (-> declined, fans out moot) / expire. THE TWO DECLINES MEAN DIFFERENT THINGS AND MUST STAY DIFFERENT: not_this on a piece = the composition was wrong; not_this_week on the plan = the timing was wrong, which is why its handler moots rather than declines the remaining pieces. That distinction IS the teaching signal 8um law 4 consumes; a partial accept is simply 'decline the ones you do not want, then Make it so'.

MATERIALIZATION. ctx :create/:invoke carry the OUTER principal (iqa.6's finding, 0k4 confirmed), so the target row's create transition names the member. target_kind is an :enum of the household's WORK kinds (task/chore_run/event/grocery_list/media — never grant/capability/approval_request/member/role/feed_recipe/recipe_proposal/value/plan), and :touches names the union literally so check-touches verifies it at assembly. That is the exact answer to the primitive iqa.6 REFUSED: only the input is data, the kind varies within a declared set — ingredient/absorb-duplicate one notch wider. target_action is :create in v1; moving an existing row is not expressible as a piece (punt).

ATOMICITY per tap; the taps are per piece. make_it_so's fan-out runs in ONE transaction (0k4 decision 1: an apply that landed nothing must not read as applied) and a refusal inside rolls the tap back and NAMES the piece. IDEMPOTENCY: no deterministic inner key (0k4 decision 2) — the verdict doors are the boundary and a second tap meets a terminal row; this is where grants/approval-effects! differs and why (post-commit, system actor, no verdict row of its own). STALE TARGET: staging validates the prepared input against the target's own create schema (0k4's the-prepared-input-fits-the-door / letter lesson), and the world is re-judged at the tap BY THE TARGET'S OWN CREATE GUARDS inside the transaction — do NOT build a second staleness oracle in the plan, it would be a second opinion about another kind's law. The household's way out is two taps: Not this on the stale piece, Make it so again.

GUARDS: names-a-value, cites-what-it-read (insight's cites-what-it-claims verbatim in shape — addresses, EVERY offender named, (nil? rdef-of) -> allow for the probe), routes-through-something-loved (absent is ALLOWED on purpose: Grandpa's paperwork routes through nothing anybody loves and a forced citation teaches the composer to invent one), a-bundle-is-small (2..5; one piece is a finding, publish an insight), plans-are-few (2 per author per CALENDAR week via store/utc-week-start, counting rows so a refused create spends nothing — insights-are-capped's shape; also enforces the not_before backoff on a superseding plan), the-prepared-input-fits-the-door, the-composer-does-not-decide (g/not-the-field :composed_by), a-person-answers. Shape first, pace last.

RESURFACE: a declined plan does NOT self-loop (a recomposed plan has different pieces and a self-loop would make the row lie); recomposition is a NEW plan citing supersedes, floored by not_before stamped from the tickler's backoff-days [7 21 60 180] pure function with now handed in.

:nav :system on both kinds (hand-written kinds inherit nothing; a :primary plan would card in do-now and be celebrated by fuel). :own-surface {:by :composed_by} on both so the composer can read what it staged and how it was answered — that IS the diagnosis feed.

FILES: two declarations in workqueue10/src/workqueue10/resources/ + main.clj's vector. No framework file, so this may run beside any waymark-8um bead. It must NOT run beside jfv.4.
acceptance_criteria: A plan stages, renders its pieces readably, accepts whole or in named parts, materializes real rows with the human as actor and the plan cited; refusals per the guards; scenarios green; suites green.
close_reason:
Landed. Two kinds in one file, workqueue10/src/workqueue10/resources/outcome.clj, plus main.clj's vector — NO framework file touched, as the landing order promised.

THE NAME: :outcome / :outcome_piece per waymark-5c4; mealplan10 keeps :plan. The spec's supersession table is in docs/spec-outcome-menu.md § 'Built — jfv.3'.

SHAPE. Parent: goal, value_id (a :kind ref with the engine-maintained value_name label copy), routing prose, optional routes_through, evidence addresses, optional supersedes; composed_by / good_until / declined_count / not_before / decided_by all engine-written. Child: outcome_id, says, target_kind (a DECLARED enum), prepared ([:map-of :keyword :any] — the first free-form map in a row schema, safe because the enum closes the KIND), materialized, composed_by, decided_by. Both :nav :system, both :own-surface {:by :composed_by :actions #{}}.

VERDICTS. Piece: take (materializes) / not_this (the composition was wrong) / moot (beside the point, teaches nothing). Parent: make_it_so (fans out take over every still-offered piece, ONE transaction) / not_this_week (fans out MOOT, and stamps not_before off the tickler's backoff with declined_count carried down the supersedes chain) / expire. The two declines mean different things and the states are where the difference lives.

WALLS. Parent create: cites-what-it-read, names-a-value, routes-through-something-loved (checked against the CITED value's own loved words; absent allowed on purpose), a-recomposition-waits-its-turn, outcomes-are-few (2/author/week, Monday 00:00 UTC via store/utc-week-start, counting rows). Piece create: the-prepared-input-fits-the-door (the target's own create model, its own three steps and order, read off ctx :rdef-of), the-outcome-is-still-open, a-bundle-is-small. Verdicts: the-composer-does-not-decide (g/not-the-field :composed_by, five doors), a-person-answers, the two leash walls, something-is-still-on-offer.

DECIDED HERE, beyond the design section: materializable = [:task :event] (grocery_list is a LINE not a row and demands a mealplan plan_id; chore_run's schedule is the chore's own law; media is a wish, not friction pre-paid); plans-are-few split into two named guards; the bundle FLOOR has no door and is filed (jfv.7); no fence for the fan-out because take declares no :edit; the-outcome-is-still-open carries no :judges because check-guard-declarations refuses one on an input-free action.

PROOF. 7 check-tier scenarios (all on the DECLINE doors — a conformance-tier action scenario would stage as the walker and make the four-eyes wall answer about the wrong person, recipe_proposal's recorded finding), 3 conformance-tier create scenarios, and 10 deftests in workqueue10/test/workqueue10/outcome_test.clj over the real ring handler: the citation walls against real values, the cap Monday to Monday, a task landing with the MEMBER on its create transition, the partial accept, not-this-week mooting the rest, and atomicity (a piece the target's own one-due refuses rolls the whole tap back).

GATES. check-queue 33 -> 35 kinds, 32 -> 39 scenarios, warnings unchanged at 11 (both kinds clean). test10 749 tests / 5481 assertions, 0 failures, twice. test-queue 224 tests / 2439 assertions, 0 failures. Exactly two fingerprints appeared and NOTHING moved (census computed with and without the two files). Stability census updated 33 -> 35.

PRODUCTION: two new tables. make migrate-queue-prod prints the plan; a person runs it through nomad. Nothing here touched production, and nothing was committed or pushed.

Filed: waymark-jfv.6 (a fan-out refusal names the target's guard, not which piece), .7 (the bundle floor), .8 (an expired outcome stamps no floor), .9 (a piece can only :create).

title: The value kind — declared law, petitioned by evidence
description: Per the spec: values declared by the owner with their loved-activity links; the amendment flow where learned signals file petitions (asks/insights) and only the owner ratifies; full household prose; scenarios for the law (a value is never amended without a ratification).
design:
Spec: docs/spec-outcome-menu.md § 'The value kind — declared law, petitioned by evidence'.

SHAPE. A hand-written kind (NOT :decision — a value is long-lived law, not a one-shot verdict): states [:declared :retired], initial :declared, terminal #{}. Fields: name (<=80, the owner's own words), says (prose), loved ([:vector [:string {:max 40}]] — free words), scope [:enum "household" "mine"], owner (ENGINE-stamped via :on-create stamp-owner — the feed_recipe precedent line for line), reviewed_at/reviewed_by (engine-stamped). Actions: revise (:edit :prefill), still_stands (self-loop :from #{:declared} :to :declared, NO input, assent), retire/restore with :undo pairs. Create + every write walled by written-by-a-person (feed_recipe's own guard shape: (= :agent (:type (:principal ctx))) -> deny, sentence NAMES the lawful path) plus this-is-yours-to-declare for scope "mine".

:nav :secondary IS LOAD-BEARING, and the bead's framing did not have it. feed/next_actions claims the OPEN rows of every :nav :primary kind and fuel speaks only about :nav :primary kinds; a value is permanently open by construction, so a :primary value cards in do-now forever and a retired one gets celebrated as a deed. feed_recipe is :secondary for exactly this reason. Note the hand-written kinds inherit no :nav — the :decision sugar is what hands tickler/insight :system for free.

LOVED ACTIVITIES: free words on the value row, and that set IS the household's vocabulary (fork decided in the spec). Not a link to eveningplan10's :activity (another domain's nouns) and not a kind of its own (a noun for a list of words). What it buys downstream is jfv.3's routes-through-something-loved guard, which reads rows and narrates the legal words in its refusal. There is no picker: a row-backed x-options source does not exist (waymark-90k), so expect an effort-honesty warning that nobody can clear until 90k lands — do not paper over it.

THE PETITION FLOW, and the code constraint that decides it: insight's create wall offers-something-light refuses any offered action heavier than 'selection', and demand/field-class reads EVERY plain string as recall (it never inspects :x-options, :maxLength or :required). So no door taking the new wording can be an insight's offer, and the petition CANNOT offer the amendment itself. v1: the agent publishes an INSIGHT — finding + evidence addresses + offer = the value's still_stands door (assent, one tap, stamps reviewed_by/reviewed_at). The owner's own revise is the ratification and the value's transitions are the record. still_stands is not hollow: 'the owner read the evidence and the value stands anyway' is the composer's most useful diagnosis signal (it separates 'the value is wrong' from 'the plan is wrong' for 8um law 4). A one-tap ratification of an EXACT wording wants 0k4's staged proposal generalized past feed_recipe — the other half of waymark-xw3, filed not built.

SCENARIOS (check tier, no storage — written-by-a-person reads only :principal): an-agent-does-not-declare-a-value; an-agent-does-not-amend-one; a-person-declares-and-amends. this-is-yours-to-declare reads the row, so it stays check tier too. The refusal sentence must name the insight path, and the scenario should assert it (:because), which is feed_recipe's own precedent.

FILES: workqueue10/src/workqueue10/resources/value.clj + the resources vector in workqueue10/main.clj (write the comment paragraph the other domainless kinds carry). NO framework file. This bead may run concurrently with any waymark-8um bead.
acceptance_criteria: Values declarable in the app; an agent's amendment attempt refuses toward the petition path; scenarios green; suites green.
